span.p:
T+0–2
A: state/control contracts, simple plant
B: run manifest, observation contract,
deterministic runner, sample audit

div.style: color: rgb(255, 234, 246) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
G0 — units, hidden info,
one complete scenario agreed

div.style: color: rgb(255, 246, 230) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Stop adding scope
resolve contracts first

div.style: color: rgb(234, 255, 240) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
T+2–6
A: battery/accounting, grip, baseline driver
B: reactive rivals, sensor masks,
tyre/context state, baseline reports

div.style: color: rgb(255, 234, 246) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
G1 — full episode; different actions
change outcome; no UI dependency

div.style: color: rgb(255, 246, 230) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Work jointly on the episode
and accounting

div.style: color: rgb(234, 255, 240) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
T+6–10
A: conditional convex profiles, supervisor
B: persistent belief, causal features,
leakage tests

div.style: color: rgb(255, 234, 246) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
G2 — decision record connects observations
to a feasible executed profile

div.style: color: rgb(255, 246, 230) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Retain tested reference; reduce grid
and candidate complexity

div.style: color: rgb(234, 255, 240) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
T+10–14
A: race continuation maps, checked paths
B: bounded scenario evaluator,
paired baselines, ambiguity cases

div.style: color: rgb(255, 234, 246) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
G3 — attack/defer/defend change
multi-lap outcomes; pass claims gated

div.style: color: rgb(255, 246, 230) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Report catch-up / opportunity,
not completed passes

div.style: color: rgb(234, 255, 240) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
T+14–18
A: thermal/tyre integration, mismatch, latency
B: frozen method selection, held-out batches,
optional feint only if stable

div.style: color: rgb(255, 234, 246) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
G4 — all required mechanisms integrated;
benchmark + failure table generated

div.style: color: rgb(255, 246, 230) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Drop optional RL, season DP,
feints; disclose smaller counts

div.style: color: rgb(234, 255, 240) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
T+18–21
A: reliability, worker cutoff, packaging
B: record-driven interface, pitch evidence

div.style: color: rgb(255, 234, 246) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
G5 — replayable demo and
reproducible result bundle

div.style: color: rgb(255, 246, 230) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Offline accelerated demo with measured
latency; no real-time claim

div.style: color: rgb(234, 246, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
T+21–24
fix blockers; rehearse; submission
freeze with buffer
